page.notes: The Greek phrase after "foetus compar parenti." is only partly legible; the letters marked [?] are uncertain. The reading of the first Greek word is doubtful. "Coruiqué" is probably "Coruique" with an abbreviation mark; the printed form was not clear enough to confirm. The line "esse" at the end of the page is set indented on the right and is the last line of the paragraph, not a new paragraph. Left edge shows part of the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
